output_list.criticism: mintToken function is used to mint new tokens. It accepts the address of the receiver and the amount of tokens to be minted. This can lead to potential token minting to the attacker. The attacker could then use these newly minted tokens to control the contract. The attacker can also control contract owner and do any action the contract owner does.
output_list.recommendation: mintToken function should check if total token supply is less than or equal to totalSupplyLimit. If yes, then proceed with the minting, else should revert.
